4th Period.workingNow: Arranging your page's elements — using simple layout properties to control spacing between sections.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Your About Me page with an external CSS stylesheet linked — custom fonts/colors, class/ID selectors, padding/margin, and an organized layout — pushed and ready to submit Sunday night.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can adjust the layout of my page's sections so that everything feels organized instead of stacked randomly.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.13 — Create prototypes using structured code, organized into separate linked pages, to fulfill a design requirement.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions.
agenda: I do: model adjusting width and centering a section (8 min)
We do: try one layout change together (7 min)
You do: adjust the layout/spacing of your page's sections (25 min)
Partner check: does your partner's layout look organized? (5 min)
4th Period.connections: This week you've gone from linking a stylesheet, to targeting elements, to spacing them out. Today you pull it together by arranging your whole page. Tomorrow you polish everything before Sunday's deadline.

6th Period.workingNow: Sketching your level layout and marking where each state gets triggered.
6th Period.weeklyDeliverable: A group platformer game plan (character states, at least one obstacle/enemy state, and a labeled level sketch) created in groups of four.
6th Period.smartGoal: I can sketch a level layout so that my group can see where each state and obstacle happens in the game.
6th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.10 — Use flowcharts and/or pseudocode to design solutions to complex problems.
6th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.1 — Exchanging information and ideas with others through collaborative discussions.
agenda: I do: model a simple level sketch with labeled trigger points (7 min)
We do: mark one trigger point together as a class (5 min)
You do: as a group, sketch your level and label every state trigger (28 min)
Exit Ticket: how many trigger points does your level have? (5 min)
6th Period.connections: Your group has a character with states and at least one obstacle. Today you place all of it into a level — sketching the layout and marking exactly where each state gets triggered. Tomorrow you finalize the whole plan.
